claims.quote: Monobactams are parenteral beta-lactam bactericidal antibiotics.

claims.text: Cross-allergy unlikely except with ceftazidime/cefiderocol (shared R1 side chain), so used for serious gram-negative infections in patients with serious beta-lactam allergy.
claims.quote: Aztreonam shares structural similarities with few other beta-lactams, making cross-hypersensitivity unlikely, except with ceftazidime and cefiderocol, which have similar R1 side chains. Thus, aztreonam is used mainly for severe aerobic gram-negative bacillary infections (including meningitis) in patients who have a serious beta-lactam allergy but who nevertheless require beta-lactam therapy.

claims.text: CAP with Pseudomonas risk: aztreonam in place of an antipseudomonal beta-lactam if allergic to or intolerant of beta-lactams.
claims.quote: Antipseudomonal beta-lactam (cefepime, ceftazidime, imipenem, meropenem, piperacillin/tazobactam) or aztreonam (if allergic to or intolerant of beta-lactams)
